body.reason: Payout confirmed paid; the 8,000.00 NGN shortfall is to be recovered by a ledger adjustment

body.detail: This caregiver still owes 800000 kobo that Paystack paid beyond their earnings, even after 0 kobo is taken from their available balance. Unfreeze with write_off_shortfall to write it off, or leave them frozen

note: write_off_shortfall is false (the default) and the available balance is 0, so there is nothing to debit the 8,000.00 NGN shortfall from: the unfreeze is refused and nothing changes.
